rules.sentence: Pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect (PAVSD) is one of the cyanotic congenital heart diseases and occurs due to the underdevelopment or maldevelopment of the right ventricular outflow tract and atresia of the pulmonary valve and trunk.
